name: Sentry Application Monitoring Integration
description: Integration pack for Sentry, providing connectivity to real-time application crash reporting, stack trace aggregation, performance APM transaction tracing, and issue assignment.

capabilities.name: Monitoring, Observability & SRE / Production Support & Incident Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Sentry real-time exception tracking, release health telemetry, and APM transaction performance metrics. Integrates Sentry unhandled exception alerts, issue grouping, and automatic assignment to engineering owners.

checklists.name: Sentry Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Sentry DSN configuration, release source maps, and issue alert webhooks.

items.statement: Sentry DSN (Data Source Name) is configured in application SDK initialization.
JavaScript source maps / symbol files upload automatically during CI build releases.
Sentry Alert rules route high-frequency new issues to team Slack/PagerDuty channels.

reviewGates.name: Sentry Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Site Reliability Engineer confirms that Sentry DSN tracking and release source maps operate properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Sentry integration verify crash reporting and symbol map resolution?

obligationDefinitions.title: A newly surfaced Sentry issue must be triaged within its severity's SLA
obligationDefinitions.description: An application error surfaced by Sentry must be triaged (assigned, prioritized, or explicitly ignored with reason) within its severity-based SLA; an unresolved, untouched issue accumulating silently is a monitoring gap in itself.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every new issue is triaged within its severity's SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: Issue triage SLA record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of issue triage timing against its severity SLA.
